runtime_image: pending - published by the runtime-image workflow from the v0.6.2 archive
scope: Candidate window only, on the owner RTX 5090 appliance. The RTX 5090 container lane moves from the feat/warm-arrival branch head d956e6d6 (shipped as v0.5.1 through v0.6.1) to the mainline runtime at 63f28c95 - the same source both native Windows lanes now build from - so the three shipped lanes converge on one tree. Production (ninfer-5090-v051p) was stopped for the window and restored on close; no published artifact, manifest, profile, or route changed.
question: Does the mainline runtime at 63f28c95, built for sm_120a on the appliance's canonical route, hold every gate the RTX 5090 lane qualified v0.5.1 on, under the unchanged v0.5.1 context-cache arguments?
answer: Yes, 7/7 gates: exact 130,048-token retrieval at 2,144 tok/s wall, 133.3 tok/s wall decode, the agent protocol across a restart, 8/8 sibling forks on private_long_anchor at 57.9K and 67.7K templates before and after a restart, warm arrival in both orders, and a 5.2 GB restore in 3.6-4.0 s with a flipped payload byte refused. Numbers are within run-to-run noise of v0.5.1 (2,180 / 133.1 / 3.8-4.4 s). The mainline runtime carries the native lanes' changes with no measurable effect on the container lane, which is what the shared tree is for.

identity.note: the appliance image wraps the exact archive binaries onto the same digest-pinned base the publish-runtime-image workflow uses (two COPYs); the published image will differ only in the layer digests the workflow's buildx produces, and the acceptance re-verifies the served binary identity from the published image

cloud_precheck.route: scripts/run_runpod_ci.py on an ephemeral RunPod RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell (compute capability 12.0, secure cloud, $0.57/h, pod retjnu8fyztrwk, deleted): full target set for sm_120a and the full ctest, run before the appliance window so the appliance's GPU time went only to the gates
cloud_precheck.result: 101/102 passed; the one failure (ninfer_gdn_gating_proj_test, workspace query/execution high-water mismatch at T=1024) is a small-SM-count artefact of the cooperative fall-through the port added for Ada - the query still sizes the preferred split - and does not occur on the 5090, 4090, or 3090 SM counts; filed as alphastorm/ninfer#42
cloud_precheck.why_not_a_3090: RunPod has no RTX 3090 in its catalog today, and the RTX 3090 lane's product is a native Windows package whose lifecycle (Task Scheduler, the named-event stop) cannot run in a Linux pod; its qualification needs its own host

context_cache_profile.unchanged_from: v0.4.8 / v0.5.1 (the deployment profile name advances, so the configuration identity advances with it)

fanout_acceptance.gate: four stored sibling forks of one template reuse the base anchor at 57.9K and 67.7K input tokens in one process, and again after a verified restart

warm_arrival.gate: after a verified restart every sibling fork of a restored template is served on private_long_anchor whether an endpoint resume or a fork arrives first, and every resume quotes the planted ledger keys exactly
warm_arrival.orders: resume-first and fork-first both every_post_restart_fork_hot with exact retrieval; resume-first sequence 4.39 / 2.88 / 1.35 s

restore.gate: a 5 GB session restores across two verified restarts with exact planted-key retrieval, and a flipped payload byte is refused

lifecycle.note: candidate ninfer-5090-v062c preflighted and started through tools/lifecycle/ninfer_container.py with image id, binary, model artifact, and configuration identity bound; preflight first refused because production still held the loopback port, which is the fail-closed behaviour the window script exists to sequence; production ninfer-5090-v051p (identity d956e6d6 / qwen38-5090-v0.5.1) restored and healthy 12 s after the window closed; zero qualification containers running

trap_recorded: a port forward through the appliance's WSL ssh alias (a ProxyCommand that reaches the distro's sshd through wsl.exe and nc) resets on the first request; forward through the Windows sshd instead, whose mirrored loopback reaches the container port directly
